title: Underived affine Hom comparison and evaluation counit
statement: Let f:X → Y be affine and A=f_*O_X be its direct-image algebra [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category]. Write T for restriction along O_Y → A, H for an additive right adjoint of T, and iH:T∘H ≅ Hom(T(A),−). Suppose its adjunction counit evaluates iH at 1 sectionwise. Since T(A) is definitionally the pushforward structure sheaf, iH followed by precomposition with O_Y → f_*O_X and canonical evaluation Hom(O_Y,F) ≅ F equals the adjunction counit for every sheaf F.

proof.text: The restricted direct-image algebra unit and the pushed-forward structure sheaf are definitionally equal, including their module structures, so use iH for j. On every open and section, unfold precomposition and the canonical unit-Hom evaluation. The value is iH of that section applied to the ring-map image of 1. The ring map preserves 1, and h_eval supplies precisely the counit value. Extensionality on opens and sections proves the equality; no finiteness, nonemptiness or nonzero ring hypothesis is used.
